{"metadata":{"description":"Follow-up suggestion chips under a DSH session's last completed reply, generated with that session's own selected model.","id":"gh:1413128356","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-followup-suggestions","slug":"YubaiLoving/dsh-followup-suggestions","topics":["chat-ui","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-client-plugin","dsh-plugin","follow-up-suggestions"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Follow-up suggestion chips under a DSH session's last completed reply, generated with that session's"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" own selected model."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** · 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# Follow-up Suggestions"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DSH plugin that renders 1-3 follow-up suggestion chips directly under a session's **last completed"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" reply**. The text is produced by **the model that session has selected**; a click fills the compose"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"r and puts your cursor in it, never sending anything. A small refresh icon next to the label asks fo"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"rsor in it, never sending anything. A small refresh icon next to the label asks for one fresh batch."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This repository carries the `dsh-plugin` topic, which the DeepSeek Harness documentation requires of"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" plugin repositories so they can be discovered; the link above is the inline, clickable form of that"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"itories so they can be discovered; the link above is the inline, clickable form of that requirement."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Generates** on the Host: it reads the Session's logged request header (`session.requestHeader()."},{"id":"p8s2","text":"config`) for the `provider/model` you picked in `/model` or the composer's model menu, and runs one "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"**one-shot** `ctx.llm.stream()` call for 1-3 short lines.
- **Renders** into ui-chat's `conversation"},{"id":"p8s4","text":".chat.turnTail` seat on the Client, ordered with `order:1` so the row sits **below** the copy/branch"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" action strip.
- **Only the last reply**: shown only when the Turn record is `status === "closed"` *"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"*and** it is the newest entry in `timeline.turnOrder`. Scrollback never requests or shows chips.
- *"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"*Click = fill the composer and enter the input state** through ui-conversation's `inputActions.setDr"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"aft()`, followed by a focus on the composer's contenteditable with the caret placed at the end of th"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"e text — so you can keep typing immediately. It never sends.
- **Refresh = one fresh batch**: the ic"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"on after the label asks the Host for this Turn's suggestions again, bypasses both caches on purpose,"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" and replaces the chips on screen and the batch cached for that Turn. A refresh that fails or comes "},{"id":"p8s12","text":"back empty changes nothing, so the chips you are reading stay. While it runs the icon spins, and the"},{"id":"p8s13","text":" button is disabled.
- **Cached**: one completed Turn costs one model call. The Host remembers settl"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ed answers and shares calls already in flight; the browser stores answers per Turn in `localStorage`"},{"id":"p8s15","text":", so a reload, a view switch, or a second tab shows the same chips with **no request at all** — unti"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"l you press refresh.
- **Silent on failure**: a gone Session, a Session with no logged route, a mode"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"l error, a dead network, or an empty answer all render nothing; empty answers and failures are delib"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"erately **not cached**, so the next visit retries.
- **No session pollution**: the call writes nothi"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"ng to the Session log, never enters model history, and never affects the KV cache."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Option 1 — plugin manager**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Option 2 — manual**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Concern | Detail |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Model choice | Routing comes entirely from the Session's own request header — the plugin has **no*"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"* model setting of its own, so switching models with `/model` switches the suggestions too |
| Conte"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"xt | `session.deriveMessages()`: the last user text plus the last assistant text, each trimmed to 12"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"00 characters of tail |
| Call | `ctx.llm.stream({ provider, model, maxTokens, reasoningEffort, sess"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ionId, messages, signal })` with an `AbortSignal.timeout` guard; `BlockAssembler` collects the strea"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"m |
| Transport | Host registers `POST /api/dsh-followup-suggest` through `ctx.connection.fetch.regi"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ster()`; the Client uses a same-origin `fetch` |
| Placement | `ctx.slots.inject("conversation.chat."},{"id":"p16s8","text":"turnTail", …)`. The seat's outlet wrapper is `display:contents`, so this row is a sibling of the act"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ion strip and `order:1` puts it below (if that container ever stops being a flex column the declarat"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"ion is ignored and the row falls back above the strip) |
| Effort | The lowest effort is requested w"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"ith a `maxTokens` cap. A route that does not know the effort answers `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`;"},{"id":"p16s12","text":" the call is then repeated without it and that route is remembered as effortless |
| "Newest" test |"},{"id":"p16s13","text":" The Turn seat has no "am I latest" prop, so the standard `useChat()` seat reads `timeline.turnOrder"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"`; when that seat is missing the row stays hidden |
| Cache key | `Session + Turn + closing final no"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"de seq`. The closing sequence makes entries self-invalidating: a retry, a branch, or a later Turn al"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"l move it |
| Host cache | Settled-answer map (256 entries / 24h) plus an in-flight promise map, so "},{"id":"p16s17","text":"two concurrent requests for one key share a single model call. Empty answers and failures are never "},{"id":"p16s18","text":"stored. A request carrying `refresh: true` skips both shortcuts, calls the model again, and replaces"},{"id":"p16s19","text":" the settled answer for the key it was handed |
| Browser cache | In-page map, then `localStorage: d"},{"id":"p16s20","text":"sh.followupSuggestions.v1` (40 entries / 7 days). The first render reads it through a lazy initializ"},{"id":"p16s21","text":"er, so a reload paints the chips with the reply. Only a refresh rewrites an entry |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Only the last reply of the session you are viewing**: intentional (fewer calls, no noise), not p"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"recomputed per session.
- **Two DOM/seat contracts**: a Turn record carrying `status`/`turn`, and `u"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"seChat().timeline.turnOrder`. If ui-chat changes either, `lib/client.js` needs the matching update.
"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"- **Depends on ui-conversation's `inputActions` and composer DOM**: without that seat the chips stil"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"l render but clicking does nothing; if `data-conversation-content`/`data-conversation-session`/`data"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"-composer-input` are renamed, a click still fills the draft but no longer moves the keyboard.
- **Ca"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"ched chips live 7 days by default**: one Turn's suggestions stay stable that long, and the refresh i"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"con is the way to ask for a new batch. Clearing `dsh.followupSuggestions.v1` from `localStorage` doe"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"s the same thing by hand.
- **A refresh costs one model call**: by design — it is the only action th"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"at bypasses both caches.
- **The Host cache is process memory**: nothing is written to disk and it e"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"mpties on restart.
- **Host-side code changes need a restart**: loaded modules are cached in the pro"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"cess (entry `config` changes are the exception — those reload immediately, and the refresh button st"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"ill works because its request misses the old Host's cache key by construction).
- **No session pollu"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"tion**: suggestions live only in browser `localStorage` and Host memory, never in the Session log, s"},{"id":"p18s15","text":"o they never appear in an export."}],"truncated":true}
